resources.name: Playful UI Runs the World
resources.creator: Liudmyla Shevchenko / Muzli
resources.description: An exploration of playful visual language, from rounded shapes and color to illustration and typography.
resources.relevance: Consider how visual choices communicate emotion before a user begins to interact.
resources.previewAlt: Official preview image — Playful UI Runs the World

resources.name: Scroll-driven Animations
resources.creator: Bramus
resources.description: Working examples of animation controlled by scroll position.
resources.relevance: Compare watching an animation with controlling how it unfolds.

resources.name: FutureSplash Animator, 1996
resources.creator: Web Design Museum
resources.description: An archive of the vector animation tool that became Macromedia Flash.
resources.relevance: A historical reference for movement and animation on the early web.

resources.name: Playful UI on Dribbble
resources.creator: Dribbble
resources.description: A collection of interface concepts, illustrations, and visual experiments tagged Playful UI.
resources.relevance: Use as a visual reference collection; individual shots may be concepts rather than working interfaces.
resources.previewAlt: Website screenshot — Playful UI on Dribbble

resources.name: Duten
resources.creator: Duten
resources.description: A product-led brand website presenting washroom fittings, material finishes, and design projects.
resources.relevance: Observe how product presentation and motion help communicate a material-focused brand.

resources.name: Playful Design on Awwwards
resources.creator: Awwwards
resources.description: A search collection for playful design across contemporary websites.
resources.relevance: Follow examples back to their original sites and assess how their interactions support communication.
resources.previewAlt: Website screenshot — Playful Design on Awwwards

resources.name: Codrops Creative Hub
resources.creator: Codrops
resources.description: A growing collection of web demos, interaction concepts, and creative coding experiments.
resources.relevance: Explore how motion and responsive feedback can turn interface ideas into working experiences.

resources.name: Antoine Wodniack
resources.creator: Antoine Wodniack
resources.description: A creative developer’s website exploring animation and interactive web experiences.
resources.relevance: Look at how navigation and feedback express the practice of creative coding.

resources.name: Sleep Well Creatives
resources.creator: Victor Costa
resources.description: A personal design experiment connecting sleep, creativity, and interactive storytelling.
resources.relevance: Study the storytelling and interaction design; the project describes itself as a creative research experiment.
resources.previewAlt: Official preview image — Sleep Well Creatives

resources.name: Nomadic Tribe
resources.creator: makemepulse / 2019
resources.description: An illustrated interactive world made for exploration.
resources.relevance: A reference for experiences where discovering the environment is central to the work.

resources.name: UI Animations with Lottie and After Effects
resources.creator: Mireia Alegre Ruiz & Emilio Rodriguez Martinez
resources.description: A guide to creating and shipping interface animations with Lottie, After Effects, and React Native.
resources.note: Available through The New School’s Ebook Central collection. Library sign-in may be required.
resources.previewAlt: Book cover — UI Animations with Lottie and After Effects

resources.name: Why Fun Matters in UX Design
resources.creator: Orly Shelef / UX Planet
resources.description: A perspective on the role of fun in digital user experiences.
resources.relevance: Read alongside questions about usability, accessibility, and when engagement becomes distraction.
resources.previewAlt: Official preview image — Why Fun Matters in UX Design
